note: Grok Bot plugins/connectors referenced by this template. Not auto-configured in Pi; add equivalent MCP servers with `pi mcp add` or .pi/mcp.json.

plugins.name: Gmail
plugins.description: Recommended. Drafts every email, reads replies and support email, and compares sent mail with drafts. Sends only when you say send.

plugins.name: Google Calendar
plugins.description: Required for the call routines. Finds watched calls, and books calls after your yes.

plugins.name: Granola
plugins.description: Optional. Call notes for learnings and follow-ups. Pasted notes work too.

plugins.name: Google Sheets
plugins.description: Optional. Lead lists, usage or credit exports, and your roster sheet.

plugins.name: Slack
plugins.description: Optional. Reads launch channels for heads-ups. Read only.

plugins.name: X
plugins.description: Optional. Finds handles and reads posts. Never follows, posts, or sends DMs. Reads bill your X API credits.
